courses.subject: ICMU
courses.title: Introduction to Clinical Medicine for Undergrads
courses.description: Students will serve as standardized patients for first-year medical students who are learning patient communication skills and physical examination techniques. The class will be spent in standardized patient encounters in the medical school clinical skills course. ICMU students will work with groups of medical students under the supervision of a faculty tutor.
courses.repeat_rules: May be repeated for credit. 2 total credits. 2 total completions.
